notes.title: VoxSys Next Fest Live Stream & Play With devs (US REGION)
notes.content:
Come and play a game with the developers during devstream. It's okay if you don't have a VR headset at home, because our game is fully cross-platform between all devices, including keyboard mouse control!

Beat us and become the 49th Intergalactic World Champion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43929487/6c235e72edabc6d9cca277410a9f8398a16f0c00.png[/img]

The Nextfest is all about the new and unexpected, and that's exactly what VoxSys offers! It's a cutting-edge VR arena shooter that seamlessly blends cooperative PvP combat with dynamic building mechanics. Your cover serves not only as protection but also as a weapon—master it to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious. 

[previewyoutube=TLu0ZI4lmAs;full][/previewyoutube]

Engage in heart-pounding battles alongside your team, utilizing a vast array of futuristic weapons and power-ups to annihilate your opponents and earn the coveted title of Intergalactic Champion. But be warned, the fully destructible sci-fi setting demands strategic thinking and expert timing.

[previewyoutube=coo8DIYoGnk;full][/previewyoutube]

Become the star of the show as the audience and commentators follow your every move, calling out your impressive shots and strategies. VoxSys is more than just a game; it's an intense and immersive event that will keep you on the edge of your seat. So what are you waiting for? It's time to build, fight, and dominate in VoxSys!
